summary: SVRN, Inc., a NASDAQ-listed, Athens-domiciled foreign private issuer (formerly OceanPal), filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 8, 2026 press release announcing its acquisition of FastNEAR, a provider of RPC infrastructure, archival data and the NEARDATA feed for NEAR Protocol. FastNEAR becomes a wholly owned subsidiary; co-founders Evgeny Kuzyakov and Mike Purvis join SVRN. Financial terms, price per share and premium were not disclosed. No board recommendation or advisor is named. FastNEAR reportedly serves over 3.5 billion requests monthly and 100+ terabytes, and SVRN says this is the first of several planned steps. Risk-arb angle: undisclosed consideration obscures value accretion; watch integration cost, customer retention and any follow-on deal or financing disclosure.
